title: Scheduled inspection.
bodyText: The administrator or any authorized inspector may schedule odometer system inspection for passenger cars at a designated time and place. Failure to move or present the passenger cars as directed or scheduled shall be a violation of this part.
bodyHtml: §486-83  Scheduled inspection.  The administrator or any authorized inspector may schedule odometer system inspection for passenger cars at a designated time and place.  Failure to move or present the passenger cars as directed or scheduled shall be a violation of this part. [L 1988, c 156, pt of §3]
